learningObjective.zh: 學習及練習與 MAKE 有關的片語動詞。
learningObjective.en: Learn and practise the phrasal verbs related to MAKE.

register.labelZh: MAKE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: make for 表示朝某人或某處移動;make off 着重迅速逃走;make away with something 則着重偷走並帶走某物。；make out 可以描述某人的聲稱,也可以表示勉強看清或聽清;make something of 則可以表達對事情的看法或理解。；MAKE 片語動詞可以描述編造故事、組成群體、改變房間用途或徹底翻新地方。；make up 可以表示和好;make it up to somebody 可以表示補償;make up to somebody 則可以表示為得到好處而討好某人。
register.summaryEn: Make for describes movement towards someone or somewhere. Make off focuses on a quick escape, while make away with something focuses on stealing and taking something away. You can use make out to describe a claim or something that is difficult to see or hear. Make something of helps you express an opinion or interpretation. The MAKE family can describe inventing a story, forming a group, changing a room into something new or completely redesigning a place. Make up can describe becoming friends again, make it up to somebody can express compensation, and make up to somebody can describe insincere friendliness used to gain an advantage.
